process MGATK_CALL {
    tag "$meta.id"
    label 'process_medium'

    conda "${moduleDir}/environment.yml"
    container "${ workflow.containerEngine in ['singularity', 'apptainer'] && !task.ext.singularity_pull_docker_container ?
        'https://depot.galaxyproject.org/singularity/mgatk:0.9.0--pyhdfd78af_0':
        'quay.io/biocontainers/mgatk:0.9.0--pyhdfd78af_0' }"

    input:
    tuple val(meta), path(bam), path(bai), path(mito_fasta)

    output:
    tuple val(meta), path("*.mgatk")                         , emit: outdir
    tuple val(meta), path("*.mgatk/final/*.rds")             , emit: rds, optional: true
    tuple val(meta), path("*.mgatk/final/*.coverage.txt.gz") , emit: coverage, optional: true
    tuple val(meta), path("*.mgatk/final/*.depthTable.txt")  , emit: depth_table, optional: true
    tuple val(meta), path("*.mgatk/final/*.A.txt.gz")        , emit: counts_a, optional: true
    tuple val(meta), path("*.mgatk/final/*.C.txt.gz")        , emit: counts_c, optional: true
    tuple val(meta), path("*.mgatk/final/*.G.txt.gz")        , emit: counts_g, optional: true
    tuple val(meta), path("*.mgatk/final/*.T.txt.gz")        , emit: counts_t, optional: true
    tuple val("${task.process}"), val('mgatk'), eval("mgatk --version 2>&1 | sed -E 's/.*version //'"), topic: versions, emit: versions_mgatk
    tuple val("${task.process}"), val('python'), eval("python --version 2>&1 | sed 's/Python //' | cut -d. -f1,2"), topic: versions, emit: versions_python

    when:
    task.ext.when == null || task.ext.when

    script:
    def args = task.ext.args ?: ''
    def prefix = task.ext.prefix ?: "${meta.id}"
    """
    ln -s $bam ${prefix}.bam
    if [[ "$bai" == *.csi ]]; then
        ln -s $bai ${prefix}.bam.csi
    else
        ln -s $bai ${prefix}.bam.bai
    fi

    mgatk call \\
        --input ${prefix}.bam \\
        --output ${prefix}.mgatk \\
        --name ${prefix} \\
        --mito-genome $mito_fasta \\
        --ncores ${task.cpus} \\
        $args
    """

    stub:
    def prefix = task.ext.prefix ?: "${meta.id}"
    """
    mkdir -p ${prefix}.mgatk/final
    touch ${prefix}.mgatk/final/${prefix}.rds
    touch ${prefix}.mgatk/final/${prefix}.signac.rds
    echo "" | gzip > ${prefix}.mgatk/final/${prefix}.coverage.txt.gz
    printf "sample\\tdepth\\n${prefix}\\t0\\n" > ${prefix}.mgatk/final/${prefix}.depthTable.txt
    for base in A C G T; do
        echo "" | gzip > ${prefix}.mgatk/final/${prefix}.\${base}.txt.gz
    done
    """
}

---
name: "nf-core/mgatk/call"
description: "Call mitochondrial variants and generate mitochondrial coverage profiles\
  \ from an indexed BAM file"
keywords:
- "mitochondria"
- "mtDNA"
- "variants"
- "ATAC-seq"
tools:
- mgatk:
    description: "Mitochondrial genome analysis toolkit"
    homepage: "https://github.com/caleblareau/mgatk"
    documentation: "https://github.com/caleblareau/mgatk/wiki"
    tool_dev_url: "https://github.com/caleblareau/mgatk"
    doi: "10.1038/s41587-020-0645-6"
    licence:
    - "MIT"
    identifier: "biotools:mgatk"
input:
- - meta:
      type: "map"
      description: "Groovy Map containing sample information\ne.g. `[ id:'sample1',\
        \ single_end:false ]`\n"
  - bam:
      type: "file"
      description: "Coordinate-sorted BAM file"
      pattern: "*.bam"
      ontologies:
      - edam: "http://edamontology.org/format_2572"
  - bai:
      type: "file"
      description: "BAM index file"
      pattern: "*.{bai,csi}"
      ontologies: []
  - mito_fasta:
      type: "file"
      description: "Mitochondrial reference genome FASTA passed to mgatk as a custom\
        \ mitochondrial genome configuration"
      pattern: "*.{fa,fasta,fna}"
      ontologies:
      - edam: "http://edamontology.org/format_1929"
output:
  outdir:
  - - meta:
        type: "map"
        description: "Groovy Map containing sample information\ne.g. `[ id:'sample1',\
          \ single_end:false ]`\n"
    - '*.mgatk':
        type: "directory"
        description: "Complete mgatk output directory"
        pattern: "*.mgatk"
        ontologies: []
  rds:
  - - meta:
        type: "map"
        description: "Groovy Map containing sample information\ne.g. `[ id:'sample1',\
          \ single_end:false ]`\n"
    - '*.mgatk/final/*.rds':
        type: "file"
        description: "R serialized objects for downstream mitochondrial variant analysis"
        pattern: "*.rds"
        ontologies: []
  coverage:
  - - meta:
        type: "map"
        description: "Groovy Map containing sample information\ne.g. `[ id:'sample1',\
          \ single_end:false ]`\n"
    - '*.mgatk/final/*.coverage.txt.gz':
        type: "file"
        description: "Per-base mitochondrial coverage table"
        pattern: "*.coverage.txt.gz"
        ontologies: []
  depth_table:
  - - meta:
        type: "map"
        description: "Groovy Map containing sample information\ne.g. `[ id:'sample1',\
          \ single_end:false ]`\n"
    - '*.mgatk/final/*.depthTable.txt':
        type: "file"
        description: "Mitochondrial sequencing-depth summary table"
        pattern: "*.depthTable.txt"
        ontologies: []
  counts_a:
  - - meta:
        type: "map"
        description: "Groovy Map containing sample information\ne.g. `[ id:'sample1',\
          \ single_end:false ]`\n"
    - '*.mgatk/final/*.A.txt.gz':
        type: "file"
        description: "Per-position adenine base-count table"
        pattern: "*.A.txt.gz"
        ontologies: []
  counts_c:
  - - meta:
        type: "map"
        description: "Groovy Map containing sample information\ne.g. `[ id:'sample1',\
          \ single_end:false ]`\n"
    - '*.mgatk/final/*.C.txt.gz':
        type: "file"
        description: "Per-position cytosine base-count table"
        pattern: "*.C.txt.gz"
        ontologies: []
  counts_g:
  - - meta:
        type: "map"
        description: "Groovy Map containing sample information\ne.g. `[ id:'sample1',\
          \ single_end:false ]`\n"
    - '*.mgatk/final/*.G.txt.gz':
        type: "file"
        description: "Per-position guanine base-count table"
        pattern: "*.G.txt.gz"
        ontologies: []
  counts_t:
  - - meta:
        type: "map"
        description: "Groovy Map containing sample information\ne.g. `[ id:'sample1',\
          \ single_end:false ]`\n"
    - '*.mgatk/final/*.T.txt.gz':
        type: "file"
        description: "Per-position thymine base-count table"
        pattern: "*.T.txt.gz"
        ontologies: []
  versions_mgatk:
  - - ${task.process}:
        type: "string"
        description: "The name of the process"
    - mgatk:
        type: "string"
        description: "The name of the tool"
    - mgatk --version 2>&1 | sed -E 's/.*version //':
        type: "eval"
        description: "The expression to obtain the version of the tool"
  versions_python:
  - - ${task.process}:
        type: "string"
        description: "The name of the process"
    - python:
        type: "string"
        description: "The name of the interpreter"
    - python --version 2>&1 | sed 's/Python //' | cut -d. -f1,2:
        type: "eval"
        description: "The expression to obtain the version of the interpreter"
topics:
  versions:
  - - ${task.process}:
        type: "string"
        description: "The name of the process"
    - mgatk:
        type: "string"
        description: "The name of the tool"
    - mgatk --version 2>&1 | sed -E 's/.*version //':
        type: "eval"
        description: "The expression to obtain the version of the tool"
  - - ${task.process}:
        type: "string"
        description: "The name of the process"
    - python:
        type: "string"
        description: "The name of the interpreter"
    - python --version 2>&1 | sed 's/Python //' | cut -d. -f1,2:
        type: "eval"
        description: "The expression to obtain the version of the interpreter"
authors:
- "@PFRoux"
maintainers:
- "@PFRoux"
